AgeCitizen.title: AgeCitizen
AgeCitizen.description: Authoritative source record held by the National Identity Authority, and the ONLY source of an AgeVerificationCredential's claims. Age assertions are derived from dateOfBirth here, at issuance, by services/age-issuer — never supplied by a wallet or a caller. Synthetic data only: see scripts/seed-age-citizens.sh. This entity belongs to the Age use case alone; DESIGN forbids a shared cross-domain person table, so Agriculture and Education must not read or extend it.

citizenId.title: Citizen ID
citizenId.description: Unique synthetic identifier, e.g. AGE-000001. The issuer counter resolves a record by this value.

name.title: Full name
name.description: Issued as a disclosable claim, but never requested by the age verifier — its presence is what makes selective disclosure demonstrable rather than assumed.

dateOfBirth.title: Date of birth
dateOfBirth.description: ISO 8601 date. The authoritative input for ageOver18 / ageOver21.
